name: Net Local Group (SA)
help: Lists groups or members; Linux and macOS support local POSIX groups only.
long_help: On Windows, type 0 lists local groups and type 1 lists members of a named local group on the selected computer. On Linux and macOS, the same modes query only the local POSIX group database; a non-empty server or domain selector is rejected.

arguments.name: type
arguments.desc: Operation mode: 0 = list all local groups (default), 1 = list members of specified group

arguments.name: server
arguments.desc: Server to query (defaults to local system if not specified)

arguments.name: group
arguments.desc: Group name to enumerate members from (required when type=1)
